english.note: Use this when something moves a person deeply or stirs strong emotion, rather than physically carrying them.

exampleSentences.english: This film really did transport me emotionally—I cried.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢套戲真係感動到我喊。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 gam2 dung6 dou3 ngo5 haam3

english.note: Use this when a person is emotionally touched or moved by something.

exampleSentences.english: Your help really does stir me.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你咁樣幫我，真係令我好感動。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 bong1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 hou2 gam2 dung6

english.note: Use this when touch means moving someone emotionally rather than making physical contact.

exampleSentences.english: The way you support me really does touch me.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你咁樣支持我，真係令我好感動。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zi1 ci4 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 hou2 gam2 dung6

english.note: Use 感動 when something arouses tenderness, compassion, or another strong feeling in someone.

exampleSentences.english: The movie's ending can really move people.
exampleSentences.traditional: 套戲個結局真係好感動人。
exampleSentences.jyutping: tou3 hei3 go3 git3 guk6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 dung6 jan4
